svg.title: pattern-lifecycle v1.0 pattern status from draft to retired
svg.text: Pattern status · from draft to retired
pattern-lifecycle v1.0 · every transition names its trigger and the owner who moves it · main path on one row, side paths below

g.text: Review to Approved needs both sign-offs in the PR; one is not enough.
Published to Deprecated needs a named successor pattern.
Deprecated to Retired waits for the CMDB to show zero consumers.
Main path: Draft → Review → Approved → Published → Deprecated → Retired. Each label is the trigger first, then the owner lane that moves it.
Not drawn on purpose: versioning inside Published (minor revisions stay Published), the CMDB consumer query, the catalog UI.
